Class ProposalStore

java.lang.Object
com.eqixiac.equinix.mcp.server.broker.ProposalStore
public final class ProposalStore extends Object
In-memory, TTL-bounded, single-use store for the Safe Mutation Broker's pending proposals, keyed by confirm token.

Scope: single-process only, like the plan store. Tokens are valid only for the lifetime of this server process; if the MCP host restarts the server, outstanding proposals are gone and must be re-proposed. Entries expire after ttl() (default 10 minutes) and the store keeps at most capacity() live proposals, evicting the oldest.

Single use, consumed on attempt: consume(String) removes a live proposal on the first attempt, before the caller executes anything — a failed execution does not resurrect the token. Recently consumed and recently expired tokens are remembered (for one further TTL window) so a second confirm gets a precise ProposalStore.Outcome.REPLAYED or ProposalStore.Outcome.EXPIRED answer instead of a generic ProposalStore.Outcome.UNKNOWN.

Thread-safe; all methods synchronize on the store. The clock is injectable for deterministic expiry tests.

    • consume

      public ProposalStore.Consumption consume(String token)
      Consumes a confirm token. A live token is removed on this attempt and returned with ProposalStore.Outcome.CONSUMED; every other outcome carries no change.
      Parameters:
      token - the confirm token presented by fabric_confirm_change
      Returns:
      the consumption result — exactly one of consumed, expired, replayed, or unknown
